subject: info-algn
title: INFO.ALGN.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-5 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's structural claim about source-initiation: 'all of the principle areas of information (knowledge) that we are now dealing with in this time zone can be researched back into the progressional rise and fall of various cultures in the world community — and as such, the surface differences of a given route of information only tell of the progressional path that information has traveled.' (C)INFO-ALGN (the concept of information alignment) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what information-alignment produces when crossed with progressional-continuance — the alignment-question being the same as the source-initiation question. Two lines leave the main line. DEC (decentralization) drops from it and leads to IST-F (isolated focus), which carries P-PROG (particular progressionalism). TR-DEF (trans-definition) branches upward from it and carries LANG-DY (language dynamics) and STF (source transfer); STF leads to ALT-F (alternative functionalism), which carries VT-DY (vibrational dynamics).
